description.narrative: UK Aid Direct (UKAD) is a competitive fund designed specifically for small and medium UK and southern-based Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) to support progress towards the global goals. The programme was designed to respond flexibly and adapt to the UK development and ministerial priorities in the context of a rapidly changing world.
